findings.finding: The new format!("{}:{}", tcx.def_path_hash(*def_id), ...) requires DefPathHash: Display. The same exporter serializes DefPathHash with {:?} in existing body and generated-glue scope IDs; no Display implementation was found in the available source tree. This prevents compiling the pinned exporter unless the type happens to gain a Display implementation outside the checked tree.
findings.action: Use {:?} for the DefPathHash field, matching the existing encoding at exporter lines 1111-1114 and preserving consistent region scope IDs.

findings.finding: The is_call matcher is inferred to consume Ast.stmt because its first alternative is Ast.ExprStmt (...). Its second alternative is Ast.CallExpr (...), which is an Ast.expr constructor, not an Ast.stmt constructor (see frontend/ast.ml:513-519 and 756 onward). The two alternatives therefore have incompatible types and the translator cannot compile.
findings.action: Remove the bare Ast.CallExpr alternative because is_call is called with the unwrapped statement, or explicitly unwrap an expression through an expression-typed helper before matching.
